doc: Binding of the optional hevm equivalence (holon/hevm_equiv.py; I20, BUILD_PLAN 'hevm equivalence between the bytecode of BatchHeaderCodecV0/V1.store* and Yul generated from the model layout, for the top codec edges'). Side A is the real store functions, called as the header build block of Rollup._commitBatchWithBatchData calls them (Rollup.sol:342-355 at the pinned commit), each field from its own calldata word, compiled with the pinned solc and morph's Foundry profile. Side B is Yul generated from the facts' encoder ops (holon.layout) for the same field words. A call argument is a model field (its calldata word, in the facts' field order) or the constant the build block passes.
